title: Kushta-e-shamsheer alamdaar
body:
Kushta-e-shamsheer alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye alamdaar... Saqqa e sakina
Abbas alamdaar, alamdaar..(2)
Peshe nigaahe shahe karbala
ghalti daye khaako khoo'n
shud parchame bawafa
nauhakuna sayyede abraar
Ah uftaad e sare karbobala ya zainab..(2)
<<MINI>>
kushta e shamsheer alamdaar
kushta e shamsheer alamdaar, alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Allah, Allah...
<<MINI>>
kushta e shamsheer alamdaar, alamdaar..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Alamdaar, Alamdaar
1. Haaye...
Ae bahan jispe naaza the hum
hogaye hai wo baazu qalam
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaaso pe fida hogaya, saqqa e sakina
pardes mein hum dono ka, dushwaar hai jeena
arey, bhai hume chhod gaya ya zainab
<<MINI>>
Ah uftaad....
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Haaye, Aaayi maqtal se jab ye sada
aaiye ibne shere khuda
jis samt se awaaz mujhe aai thi behna
mai thokre khaata hua us simt hi nikla
arey, raah mein ek bazu mila, ya zainab
<<MINI>>
Ah uftaad....
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Haaye.... Phir usi samt mai chal diya
aai thi jis taraf se sadaa
jab dusra bazu mila, us shere jari ka
dil dard se lachaar hua, tere akhi ka
arey, hoto pe aayi ye buka, ya zainab
<<MINI>>
Ah uftaad....
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Haaye...
Aye bahan thaam lo dil zara phir wo lamha qareeb aagaya
be dast alamdaar ko, jab khaak pe dekha
us sher ki peshani pe, ek gurz laga tha
arey, dil pe wahi gurz laga, ya zainab
<<MINI>>
Ah uftaad....
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haaye... Phir wo karne laga yu kalaam
ibne zehra ho tumpar salaam
mai roke ye bola ke, zara aankhein to kholo
aye bhai agar koi, wasiyat hai to kehdo
arey, sunke jari rone laga, ya zainab
<<MINI>>
Ah uftaad....
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Haaye...
Roke ghaazi ye kehne laga
arz itni hai shahe huda
mai mashk pe qurbaan hua, ye to batana par laash meri khaime mein, lekar nahi jaana
arey, maine bhi aisa hi kiya, ya zainab
<<MINI>>
Ah uftaad....
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Haaye...
Sunke zainab ne nauha kiya
ab chinegi yaqeenan rida
aye mazharo irfan wo, qayamat ka tha manzar
<<DIVIDER>>
ghaazi ki bahan aagayi, khaimo mein tadapkar
arey
khaimo mein kohraam utha...
Haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar, haye alamdaar
<<DIVIDER>>
